ChangeNotes.Value: v1.3.2 - Fixed: settings changed at the main menu could be silently reverted. Editing Mod Options before loading a campaign - switching the Backend, pasting an API key, picking a model - could fail to reach the mod's config and quietly snap back when the campaign started, leaving errors like 'Anthropic API key is not set' after choosing OpenRouter. Settings now take hold wherever and whenever you edit them, main menu included. If this bit you: update, set your Backend (and key) once more, and it sticks.
